name: 趋光本能
detailed_description:
Welcome to Light Instinct: an exploration game that combines romance with puzzle-solving suspense elements.

In this love visual novel, you will explore a mysterious apartment. Be careful - under the seemingly warm daily life, there is a carefully designed stage.

Game Features

· Meet three girls, develop exclusive stories and emotional ties.

· Multiple routes, your choices determine their endings.

· Freely investigate the environment, collect clues and props, solve puzzles, and gradually piece together the truth of the incident.

Are you ready to start this apartment life?

Can the warmth of your fingertips and the girl you like lead you to that "beautiful" future?

Or... should you follow the lingering sense of disharmony in your heart?

Those repetitive flashing images, overly coincidental clues, whispers in your ears... what do they want to tell you? Is it the key to reveal the truth, or another trap?

In this apartment, there is a choice behind every door. The clues you pick up and the trust you give... will eventually reflect your true "awakening" at the end of the corridor.
